description: Longway is a fictional road-trip company: a Zyqor Studio design concept built with Video Flow, a scroll-scrubbed real-footage page where scrolling drives a mountain pass.

hero.title: Longway
hero.sub: Mountain passes, slow miles, no fixed itinerary. Scroll to drive the road.

beats.title: Take the / long way
beats.body: We plan road trips around the drive itself: the bends, the weather, the stops nobody puts on a list.

beats.title: Clouds / below you
beats.body: Our routes climb past the cloud line before breakfast, so the view does most of the talking.

beats.title: Fuelled, / mapped, yours
beats.body: A prepped 4x4, offline maps, a stove in the back and someone on call if the road has other ideas.

beats.title: 180 km / a day, max
beats.body: Short days on purpose. You arrive mid-afternoon, with time left to actually stop and look.

specs.title: Built for / the drive
specs.body: These are the specs of a concept trip, not a real booking. The whole page is generated from one config file and one video.

items.label: a typical loop, start to finish
the most we drive in a day

strip.title: One drive. / {frames} frames.
strip.body: Real footage of a mountain pass, cut into {frames} frames and drawn to a canvas as you scroll. Tap a frame to drive back to it.

cta.title: The road / is open
cta.body: A concept for a fictional road-trip company. Nothing is for sale; the road is real.
cta.note: Zyqor Lab concept. Fictional brand, real footage.
